result.title: AI Discovery in Combinatorics: From Problems to Solutions and Back to Bigger Problems
result.summary: We introduce $qt$Bench, a benchmark of 29 open problems in algebraic combinatorics. These problems ask for a simple combinatorial algorithm that explains given polynomial coefficients or identities. To help AI agents search for such algorithms, we provide a scaffold for playing with combinatorial objects, countering cheating attempts, and testing candidate solutions. To explore how far frontier AI systems can go on these problems, we collaborated with OpenAI, whose researchers obtained proposed solutions to several of them. This highlights bigger meta-problems: is AI discovery at scale ethical? How should these results be released? How should proof digestion be organized? We discuss these questions and give our views.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 qtBench，收录 29 个代数组合学开放问题，要求给出解释给定多项式系数或恒等式的组合算法，并提供操作组合对象、防作弊与候选解测试的脚手架；与 OpenAI 合作考察前沿 AI 的进展，并讨论大规模 AI 发现的伦理与结果发布等元问题。
